scripts.build: bun run build:companions && bun run --cwd apps/desktop build:web
scripts.build:companions: bun run --cwd apps/agents-server build:binary && bun run --cwd apps/executor build:binary
scripts.smoke:three-process: bun run build:companions && bun run --cwd apps/agents-server build:smoke-binary && bun run ./scripts/smoke-three-process.ts
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd packages/deepagents build:types && bun run --filter '@moshu/*' typecheck
scripts.test: bun run test:unit && bun run test:companions && bun run test:web
scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test
